title.narrative: In 2024 UNICEF conducted a study on child poverty to guide policies and programmes. The CO also strengthened social protection with inclusive, data-driven approaches to support children and vulnerable communities. Finaly, support was provided on child right reporting mechanisms and on the development of new initiatives toward child poverty reduction.
